title: The kitchen timer
hints: Write the union first: `TimerInput` is four types joined with `|`. Then peel the cases off one at a time in `timerSeconds`, returning early, so each check leaves fewer possibilities.

`typeof input === "number"` handles seconds, and `typeof input === "string"` leaves only the presets (compare or `switch` on them). What's left is one of the two objects, and `"hours" in input` tells them apart. In `countdownText`, check `remaining === null`, not `!remaining`, or 0 will show as dashes.

if ("hours" in input) return input.hours * 3600 + input.minutes * 60; return input.minutes * 60 + input.seconds;  and for the display: `${Math.floor(remaining / 60)}:${String(remaining % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`
